name: GDP GROWTH
label: Quarterly economic output
description: Quarterly GDP growth YoY, adjusted for parallel import volumes and sanctions-driven output distortions. Source: Rosstat + IMF shadow estimates.

name: INFLATION RATE
label: Consumer Price Index YoY
description: Monthly CPI % year-on-year with shadow-economy multiplier (×1.18). Real purchasing power decline estimated at 18–22%.

name: SENTIMENT SCORE
label: Social + media signals
description: Aggregated sentiment from Telegram channels, VK public groups, and Yandex News. Scored 0–100 (100 = fully positive). ML classification pipeline.

name: PUBLIC POLLS
label: Life satisfaction index
description: Composite of Levada Center, independent regional polls, and emigrant perception surveys, adjusted for social desirability bias.

name: EMIGRATION INDEX
label: Monthly departures (thousands)
description: Monthly emigration estimates from border data, residency permit applications in Georgia, Armenia, EU, and relocation platform analytics.

name: NEWS NEGATIVITY
label: Press freedom + tone index
description: Daily negativity ratio in 200+ monitored outlets. Tracks proportion of fear/conflict/crisis keywords. RSF press freedom index integrated.

name: ROSSTAT GAP
label: Official vs. shadow statistics
description: Divergence multiplier between Rosstat figures and independent economic estimates (BOFIT, Yale CELI). Higher = greater statistical opacity.

name: ECON. FREEDOM
label: Heritage Foundation index (0–100)
description: Heritage Foundation Economic Freedom Index score. Russia ranks 162nd globally. Tracks property rights, government integrity, trade freedom.

name: RUBLE / USD
label: Exchange rate index (base 2021=100)
description: USD/RUB exchange rate monthly close. Spike in March 2022 reflects sanctions shock. Subsequent stabilisation due to capital controls and export revenue mandates.
